punchline: One missing DNA letter in an aphid's bacteria made the aphids heat-sensitive and cold-fast.
thirty_sec: In a 2007 study, pea aphids whose Buchnera bacteria lacked one adenine in a heat-shock promoter rarely reproduced after four hours at 35 or 38 degrees, yet reproduced faster at 15 and 20 degrees. The mutation turned up in about 21 percent of Wisconsin aphids.
question: Which of your strengths at work has only ever been tested in calm conditions, and what would a hot week do to it?
key_contrast: The same mutation costs the aphid in heat and rewards it in cold.
